title: Same Page · Puzzle 1
brief: Find a four-digit code together, using this document as your shared scratchpad. Each of you has been given some of the clues; nobody has them all. When you both agree, write the line ANSWER: followed by the four digits. You can't change your answer after you both say done.

secrets.claude: Your clues: (a) all four digits are different; (b) the first digit is twice the last digit; (c) the four digits add up to 20.
secrets.codex: Your clues: (d) the second digit is the largest of the four; (e) the third digit is odd; (f) the last digit is even.
